story:
Arjun and the Lost Homework

In a small town, lived a boy named Arjun.

Arjun was smart and playful.

But there was one problem…

He often didn’t take responsibility for his mistakes.

One day, Arjun had homework to complete.

“I’ll do it later,” he said.

Instead, he went out to play.

When he came back, he was too tired.

“I’ll do it tomorrow,” he said.

The next day at school, the teacher asked,

“Where is your homework, Arjun?”

Arjun looked down.

“I… I lost it,” he said.

But that wasn’t true.

He just hadn’t done it.

The teacher looked at him kindly.

“Arjun, it’s okay to make mistakes,” she said.

“But it’s important to be honest and take responsibility.”

Arjun felt ashamed.

“I’m sorry,” he said.

“I didn’t do my homework.”

That evening, Arjun sat down and finished his homework.

He worked carefully.

The next day, he gave it to his teacher.

“Well done,” she said.

From that day on, Arjun did his work on time.

And if he made a mistake, he told the truth.

Always be honest and take responsibility for your actions.

The End
